resource_identity.syntax: Strict resource basename, optional -js, optional observed -fe variant, delimiter and exact 1..16 hexadecimal revision
resource_identity.normalization: Preserve -fe in canonical resource key; never alias a native compiled variant to an old bundled role profile
resource_identity.diagnostic_disclosure: New native resource identifiers matching strict syntax may be disclosed without the bundled-only basename allowlist. Paths, URLs and arbitrary strings remain excluded.
resource_identity.production_role_authorization: Resource family + singular typed semantic paths + per-instance native consumer ownership. Revision remains diagnostic/instance identity, never an admission allowlist for the two live recipes.

native_lookup.scheduling: Main queue after the current native materialization; never inside the URI getter or a synchronized lookup lock
native_lookup.retries: Unavailable native configuration only: at most three attempts, delays 0.5 and 2 seconds
native_lookup.lifecycle: Capture epoch invalidates queued work and retries on reset
native_lookup.payload: Only provider-returned static template configuration requested by a validated resource key; live browsing-model values are never exported
native_lookup.format_limit: Report format, hash, field shape and bounded base64 configuration. A returned configuration can be only a reference; its actual contents must be inspected before selecting the template decoder.
native_lookup.live_fe_policy: Do not query global legacy serialized-config provider for FE keys; record native_consumers_required and inspect the owned materialized inputs.

ownership: Capture only main-thread matched controller entries with section/index scope, ordinary YTVideoElementCellController or explicit watch metadata owner, and a checked negative ad-presence flag
model_inventory: Breadth-first structural paths include field and occurrence index. Store field/wire/count/length, first failed candidate step and salted candidate-ID hashes. No model base64, titles, personal IDs or thumbnail URLs.
candidate_policy: All discovered paths/IDs are inspection candidates, never permission to request a video or rewrite a node
checkpoints: D04_live_configuration_captured with availability, lookup count and export status
D04_role_bound only after an independently verified profile actually binds
D05_policy_evaluated through service/fallback/projection/refresh remain downstream of verified roles
next_device_capture: Start DeArrow diagnostic capture in Settings, then close Settings.
Scroll newly configured Home cards, open a video, and scroll related rows.
Tap a description timestamp/chapter and Comments. Wait for replacement/fallback.
Copy DeArrow checkpoints; identify the first missing D stage and the W trace for each failed tap.
If taps still fail, repeat with both DeArrow title/thumbnail options disabled and a fresh app launch.
activation: Only explicit Start DeArrow diagnostic capture enables expensive live model/configuration inspection; general diagnostics alone does not
sampling: resource + surface + accepted semantic video/rejected ordinary/generic + command chain/failure + structural shape

watch_trace.activation: Explicit Start DeArrow diagnostic capture only

stages.W01: Native window touch with receiving view/ancestor/recognizer state
stages.W03: Native node tap or text-link path
stages.W04: Elements command bridge entry/return; original arguments and completion forwarded unchanged
stages.W05: Native presentation or seek requested; no inference of successful completion

directed_navigation: Complete bounded typed wrapper chain, terminal WatchEndpoint extension, validated salted identity and failure path/parent shape. No raw IDs, titles or URLs.

primitive_ancestry.start: Native node controller, or the typed component/controller itself.
primitive_ancestry.scope: Exact native ELMElement occurrence and current row/generation; independent edge traversal; reject competing accepted row occurrences, ambiguity and truncation. Stop at the proven occurrence boundary.
primitive_ancestry.materialization: Read-only existing graph. Preserve loaded-state guard; no guessed memory layout, lazy node forcing, global setter hooks or view-tree ancestry.

primitive_diagnostics.exported: Class/edge names, bounded resolved ancestry, original-role equality booleans, loaded/content presence, counts and truncation. No raw content, IDs, URLs or addresses.
primitive_diagnostics.role_adapters: ELMTextNode and ELMImageNode remain reviewed consumers. ASTextNode and expandable text candidates are observed without authorizing unreviewed title roles.

watch_title_classification: A supported watch title with validated explicit watch video and title input uses the accepted semantic slot.

nested_collection_capture.slots: One per shelf family and nested child resource per surface, within the unchanged 24-root session cap
nested_collection_capture.boundaries: Read-only per-item serialized renderers and diffable serialized child inputs; no collection lazy getters or opaque aggregate getters
